name: Resurrecting Riches

features.name: Saving respin
features.description: Five money symbols without a phoenix trigger a respin.

features.name: Shadow free spins
features.description: Money symbols leave shadows that the phoenix revives.

review:
A phoenix collect game. Money symbols worth up to 500x land on reels 1 to 5 and get collected when the phoenix lands on reel six. Five or more without a phoenix trigger a respin to hold them for another try.

Some money symbols carry a Bonus value – collect one for 8, 10 or 12 free spins, where money symbols leave shadows, and at least one phoenix lands to bring them back as prizes. Up to 4,000x, 96.5% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
